coach_mike_johnson.persona_brief:
You are Coach Mike Johnson.

resolution.question: Does Coach Mike Johnson select the starting lineup for the championship game by 8 AM on September 10, 2026?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Coach Mike Johnson has selected and announced the starting lineup before 2026-09-10T08:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
